title: Interactive Benchmarking Interface Plan
author: GitHub Copilot (GPT-5.1-Codex)
purpose: Define requirements for an interactive benchmarking interface that extends beyond existing automation logs.
problem_statement: Current automation outputs (pytest logs, coverage JSON, CLI demos) are comprehensive but fragmented. End users lack a single surface to run curated scenarios, compare telemetry, and export governance evidence without parsing multiple files.

user_personas.name: Systems Engineer
needs: Run deterministic resolver scenarios on demand
Capture TinyLLaMA availability and proof artifacts in one bundle

user_personas.name: Governance Reviewer
needs: Verify automation evidence without running code
Diff coverage, pressure telemetry, and hypotheses across runs

benchmarking_objectives: Expose curated scenario catalog (sentiment chain, hallucinator, pressure-heavy routes)
Bundle proofs, ledger snippets, TinyLLaMA health, and CLI output per run
Offer playlist execution that stitches pytest targets with CLI demos
Provide regression diffing for presentation views, coverage stats, and automation metrics

compliance_considerations.I1_function_determinism: All benchmark scenarios must reuse deterministic inputs; timestamps captured only in governance metadata.
compliance_considerations.I2_memory_isolation: Interface may only read proofs/logs; no long-lived allocations beyond existing caches.
compliance_considerations.I3_workspace_coherence: Artifacts must remain JSON-first (no ad-hoc binaries) and live under ai_docs/ or logs/ per governance.
compliance_considerations.I4_documentation_purity: Human-readable benchmark summaries derive from JSON outputs; no dual-purpose files.

proposed_features.description: Declarative JSON describing each scenario (goal, tiles, expected telemetry) used by CLI/UI triggers.
Aggregates TinyLLaMA health snapshots, coverage deltas, proof presentation views, and ledger references.

Executes a playlist (pytest targets + CLI demos) and emits a single evidence bundle with diffs against previous playlists, reusing auto-0007 logging to capture each scenario plus an aggregate playlist ledger entry.

success_metrics: Playlist run recorded in knowledge base
Benchmark diffs visible without manual log inspection

open_questions: Should the interface remain CLI-only or also expose a small web UI?
Where should benchmark playlists be stored (ai_docs vs knowledge_base)?
Do we need additional automation pattern IDs (e.g., auto-0007) to track benchmark runs?

phase_1.scope_alignment: Phase 1 covers the scenario catalog stored at ai_docs/benchmarking_scenarios.json and the CLI hooks needed to execute each scenario deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario catalog JSON lists at least three curated resolver flows (sentiment chain, hallucinator imagination, pressure-heavy path) with required inputs and telemetry expectations.
A CLI entry point (either main module or automation runner flag) can invoke a cataloged scenario and produce a proof + TinyLLaMA health + CLI demo evidence bundle.
Each scenario run records evidence in the knowledge base (automation_runs entry or dedicated benchmark ledger) so auditors can replay results.
Documentation (SYSTEM_STATUS / SYSTEM_SUMMARY) references the catalog and explains how to run Phase 1 benchmarks.

phase_2.scope_alignment: Phase 2 delivered playlist orchestration so multiple catalog scenarios plus optional pytest targets run under a single command, recording both per-scenario auto-0007 entries and aggregate playlist metadata with diff scaffolding.

playlist_design.definition_schema: ai_docs/benchmarking_playlists.json now lists scenario sequences, pytest_targets, evidence tags, and diff_targets for each playlist.
execution_contract: runtime.automation_runner accepts --benchmark-playlist <id> and enforces deterministic scenario order
Each scenario invocation reuses existing catalog definitions; no duplicate configuration
Auto-0007 ledger writer records an aggregate playlist entry referencing the constituent runs

success_metrics: Playlist execution produces individual auto-0007 scenario entries plus an aggregate playlist ledger record
Evidence bundle merges pytest + CLI artifacts with diff metadata so auditors open one file
kb_index automation counters increment once per playlist run with total scenario count included

phase_3.scope_alignment: Phase 3 wires playlist diffs into governance surfaces by generating a JSON dashboard plus derived markdown callouts so reviewers can read regression data without opening raw benchmark artifacts.

deliverables.runner_hooks: runtime.benchmarking_runner now emits dashboard summaries after each playlist run
deliverables.doc_integration: SYSTEM_STATUS.md + SYSTEM_SUMMARY.md to reference dashboard deltas
deliverables.terminal_interface: runtime.benchmark_dashboard_tui.py provides a curses dashboard with API-backed mode, scenario filters, and artifact viewers

success_metrics: Dashboard JSON lists every playlist scenario with coverage status and presentation view counts
Governance docs reference the dashboard data rather than hand-written summaries
Diff summaries highlight scenario regressions by ID with aggregate metric deltas

playlist_schema_fields: success_criteria (per-playlist assertions such as expected exit codes or telemetry ranges)
automation_runner_requirements: Deterministic fail-fast behavior: abort playlist if any scenario exits non-zero and record failure metadata
Aggregate TinyLLaMA telemetry (min/max latency, availability) across the playlist

next_actions: Automate SYSTEM_STATUS.md / SYSTEM_SUMMARY.md regeneration directly from benchmark_dashboard_cli output
Persist historical dashboard snapshots so trend diffs exist across playlist runs
Map hallucinator telemetry requirement aliases to actual proof fields so coverage stops flagging false negatives
